scope.purpose: Attach an observed-only DevelopmentTrace/trace_summary to eligible DSAI3V post-merge completion whenever PR-head GitHub Actions timestamps are available.

fail_honest_rules: MODEL_REASONING remains UNAVAILABLE absent explicit measured platform telemetry
missing workflow timing does not fabricate latency and leaves canonical latency UNAVAILABLE
workflow-green-to-physical-merge is elapsed observed time only and is not attributed to a causal wait class
no local-test, remediation, polling, operator-wait or assistant-configuration duration is inferred from GitHub timestamps
existing four-receipt completion and exact-tree requirements remain unchanged
tests_required: existing DSAI3V local completion executor tests
rollback: Forward-revert the bounded trace assembly and trace arguments; preserve the existing four-receipt post-merge completion path and all already-persisted diagnostic evidence.
explicit_non_authority: no merge or physical-main authority change
